name: perssua
description: Start Perssua sessions with a configured assistant and context, straight from Claude.
long_description: Connects Claude to the Perssua desktop app on this machine. Claude can check the app, list your assistants, start a session with an assistant + context + text files, create a brand-new custom assistant from a guided interview, and build clickable session links. Requires the Perssua app (https://perssua.com) installed and opened at least once.

tools.name: app_status
tools.description: Check whether the Perssua app is installed and running.

tools.name: list_assistants
tools.description: List the user's configured Perssua assistants.

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Launch Perssua with an assistant, context, files, and an initial prompt.

tools.name: create_assistant
tools.description: Create a new custom Perssua assistant (name, instructions, knowledge) and open a session with it.

tools.name: create_session_link
tools.description: Build a clickable perssua:// session link.

prompts.name: new_assistant
prompts.description: Guided interview that designs a new Perssua assistant and creates it.
prompts.text: Interview me about the assistant I need (goal, style, knowledge, kickoff), then call create_assistant.
